column2: Adverbial clauses of time with when / before / after · 阶段复盘(第2轮)
A time adverbial clause introduced by when/before/after/as soon as; the future is expressed with the present.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。
when + point in time|before = before, after = after|main clause future, subordinate clause present|as soon as = as soon as|while + continuous action
I will call you when I get home.
column3: 我到家后会给你打电话。

column4: 考查The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。此处应为 get。句意:我到家后会给你打电话。
